values.meaning: magic damage from a regular (uncharged) zap basic attack
values.binNote: The wiki's per-level formula 10+(15/17)*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1)) is quadratic and matches the bin's endpoints (10 at level 1, 25 at level 18) but not its intermediate values: the bin's ZeriQ#MinDamage flat array is a plain linear interpolation (10, 10.882353, 11.764706, ...) between the same endpoints. This is a genuine disagreement between the wiki's stated formula and the bin's linear array; the wiki's numbers are recorded here.

values.meaning: health threshold below which a regular zap executes the target
values.quote: the target if they are below {{pp|70 + (160-70)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=hp}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}}

cap on the target-max-health portion of the full-charge attack against monsters

values.meaning: maximum charge Zeri can hold before her next attack becomes the empowered full-charge attack
values.quote: up to a maximum of 100 charge
values.binNote: No numbers sheet row directly under P's own header stores the 100-charge cap or the 10-charge-per-40-units/10-per-Q-cast rates; these are only stated in the wikitext description, so bin is [].

mechanics.claim: Zeri generates 1 charge for every 40 units she travels by any means and 10 charge every time she casts Burst Fire, up to a maximum of 100 charge.
mechanics.quote: generates 1 charge for every 40 units she travels by any means and 10 charge every time she casts ''{{ai|Burst Fire|Zeri}}'', up to a maximum of 100 charge

mechanics.claim: Basic attacks consume charge (10 for a regular zap, all 100 for the empowered full-charge attack) to deal modified damage instead of normal auto-attack damage.

Zeri's charged/uncharged basic attacks apply spell effects as spell damage and trigger on-cast effects, but do not deal physical damage and cannot critically strike nor trigger on-hit or on-attack effects.
mechanics.quote: '''Zeri's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} apply {{tip|spell effects}} as {{tip|spell damage}} and trigger on-cast effects, but they do not deal {{as|physical damage}} and '''cannot''' {{tip|critically strike}} nor trigger {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|on-attack}} effects.

mechanics.claim: Uncharged attacks do not execute enemies that are shielded or invulnerable while below the health threshold.
mechanics.quote: Uncharged attacks do not execute enemies that are {{tip|shield|shielded}} or {{tip|invulnerable}} while below the health threshold.

mechanics.claim: Charged (full-charge) attacks only deal the base flat damage component to structures, ignoring the AP and max-health ratios.
mechanics.quote: Charged attacks only deal the '''base''' damage to {{tip|structures}}.
